contract: a columnar spire: a four-stage tapering core with four planar fin blades and a lit crown, standing in a ring podium reached by a colonnaded causeway - inside V24-116 / U527-598 and not one cell outside it
requires_in_game: colour and the read of the value ladder can only be judged in world
no mechanism is claimed by this geometry: the Ascent's timing, the Array's route lights and the Vault's completion circuit are separate redstone tickets

role_contracts.building: legal states, supported attachments, accessible entries, and interior clearance
role_contracts.construction: legal states, supported placements, stable components, and an auditable bill of materials
role_contracts.ride: route/rail topology plus reachable boarding, exit, and safety paths

brief.narrative: A spire: a square core tapering through four stages from thirteen across to seven, each stage landing on its own corbelled setback, four planar fin blades on the cardinal faces whose reach shortens from twelve to two as they rise, and an open crown of posts, bars and froglight with five end-rod finials. It stands in the court of a ring podium, reached from the spine by a colonnaded causeway on the spur's own axis.

fun_contract.outcome: The crown's signal ring stands eighty-four courses over the lawn and reads from the whole park; from inside the podium court the four fins and the four setbacks are all visible at once, which is the thing a photograph of it will show.
